acceptance: Loading a completed cleanup.json whose introduced_fusion_count is null raises CleanupDocumentError and never leaks TypeError.

Each required blocking quality metric is present as a non-boolean integer; malformed or missing values and nonzero values are rejected as CleanupDocumentError, while zero-valued valid metrics remain accepted.

Progress fields required by the Cleanup V2 contract and by resume/manifest projection are validated for required keys and safe shapes so missing or malformed progress data raises CleanupDocumentError rather than a downstream KeyError, TypeError, or AttributeError.
Opening a project whose cleanup.json contains a malformed blocking quality metric returns a normal project validation result with status ok or repair_required instead of propagating an exception.
Existing valid Cleanup loading, completion evidence, resume, manual-edit, and project-repair behavior remains unchanged under focused regression coverage.

Focused Cleanup and project-workspace tests, Ruff, and traceability/coverage audits pass; the human manually verifies the application before publishing, and the full pytest suite is not run for this ticket by explicit instruction.
assumptions: project_workspace_service's existing OSError/ValueError completion-evidence boundary and metadata-healing policy are intentional; the fix belongs in text_cleanup_service rather than a broader consumer catch or new repair-status rule.
alignment.reason: The defect is confined to one strict document boundary, the exception contract is established, the original ticket explicitly accepts either normal project-validation status, focused tests bound the change, and the human accepted focused automated validation plus manual application testing.
scope: In scope: strict validation of the Cleanup progress structure and completed-document blocking quality metrics; normalization of malformed loaded data to CleanupDocumentError; focused loader and project-open normal-return regressions; durable requirements, Cleanup V2 specification detail, and Text Cleanup/Project Lifecycle documentation review. Out of scope: Cleanup metric generation, renderer semantics, non-Cleanup artifacts, UI changes, broad TypeError catches in project_workspace_service, changes to project metadata-healing policy, schema migration/versioning, chunking behavior, unrelated validation hardening, and the full pytest suite explicitly deferred by the human due runtime.
alignment.source: Gitea issue #33: http://192.168.1.15:3001/dpasare/2026_AudioMancer/issues/33; remediation order in issue #40; validation override from human on 2026-07-29
alignment.understanding: The strict Cleanup document validator currently coerces four blocking quality metrics with int(), allowing malformed JSON values such as null to leak TypeError instead of the documented CleanupDocumentError. Because project completion evidence intentionally catches OSError and ValueError, that leak crashes project opening instead of treating Cleanup completion evidence as unavailable and returning through the normal project validation flow. Harden the validator at the document boundary, including the progress fields consumed by resume and manifest projection, while preserving the existing valid Cleanup schema and project-workspace exception policy.
